text: QUALCOMM Incorporated is Nasdaq-listed (QCOM). Per its 2026 proxy statement, its only disclosed 5%+ shareholders are Vanguard Group Inc. (10.53%) and BlackRock, Inc. (8.71%), with no state or sovereign-fund shareholder identified.

source.name: QUALCOMM Incorporated DEF 14A 2026 Proxy Statement (SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: each stockholder known to us to have greater than a 5% ownership interest (based solely on our review of Schedules 13D and 13G filed with the SEC)
